Devotion +72: Passive: +72 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Healing Lore V: Passive: Your Positive Energy spells gain a 15% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Nullification +72: Passive: +72 Equipment bonus to Negative (Necrotic) and Poison Spell Power.
Void Lore V: Passive: Your Negative Energy and Poison spells gain a 15% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Efficient Metamagic - Empower Healing II: The additional spell point cost for using the Empower Healing Metamagic feat is reduced by 2 SP.
